> 第5章 毒珠之威（第1页）
第二天清晨，陈长生伸了个懒腰站起身来，随即拉开废丹房的大门，外面阳光明媚，小鸟啾啾，不由心情大好。
就在这时，一名虎头虎脑的小胖子探头探脑的走了过来，有些羞怯的问道：“你是陈长生师兄吗？”
陈长生打量几眼这个小胖子，发现他白白胖胖的，虎头虎脑的样子，眼神很是清澈。
那少年摸了摸后脑勺有点怪不好意思的，“我叫张大虎，隔壁灵兽园的，我听说了你的遭遇，觉得怪可怜的，给你送点吃的过来。”
说完他从怀里摸出一只裹了荷叶的烧鸡递了过来，“给。”
“啊！那就多谢了，张师兄要不进来坐坐？”陈长生看着这小胖子不由心中一暖，看来世界上还真的是好人多啊！
张大虎摆了摆手，“不了，我还得去给灵兽清理粪便呢，就先走了。”
张大虎走了两步又转过身来道：“小心那个李怀安，这家伙名声可不太好。”
“嗯，你吃吧，等有时间我再给你送吃的。”小胖子说完屁颠屁颠的就走了。
这烧鸡陈长生没有吃，把其送给了在废丹房深处睡觉的丹老。
丹老看见烧鸡眼睛顿时眯成了一道缝，“烧鸡好啊，烧鸡配美酒，人生一大快事！”
就在这时，有人送来了一车废丹，居然是常隆。
常隆欲言又止，但最终什么都没有说，转身离开了。
陈长生也没有和其打招呼，自己就是替此人背的锅，结果他一句求情的话都不说，就有点说不过去。
废丹的底下压着两百块下品灵石，还有一些辟谷丹。
陈长生把这些灵石和辟谷丹都收了，这是他应得的，看来这个常隆还算是个人，并没有完全泯灭人性。
就在这时，一行三人大摇大摆走了进来，居然是李怀安和他的两名跟班。
陈长生看着此人眼神一寒，“李怀安，你还敢来？”

李怀安眼神一扫，就看见那些还没来得及收起来的灵石和辟谷丹，不由眼睛一亮，“陈长生，我本来今天来是想要好好揍你一顿，但如果你把这些灵石和丹药给我，我就不揍你了！”
“不错，陈长生，你一个废物一辈子躲在废丹房，要这么多灵石也没法修炼，不如孝敬我们。”
“是啊，你的这些东西是常隆给你的吧，我们就替你收了。”
李怀安是炼气五层的修为，他身边那两人也是炼气三层，单对单陈长生按说一个都不是对手。
不过陈长生屈指一弹，一枚毒丹忽然猛的爆炸开来，顿时一股黑烟弥漫开来。
李怀安三人一阵手忙脚乱，开始驱毒，他们体内的灵气都开始运转不畅了。
陈长生一拳把李怀安打倒在地，随即一脚踏在他的胸口，“李怀安，我沦落至此，全凭你所赐，你居然还敢来找麻烦！”

After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible. The latest chapter_Chapter 5 The Power of the Poison Pearl Page 1_After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible to a green lotus_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 5 The Power of Poison Pearl (Page 1)
Early the next morning, Chen Changsheng stretched and stood up, and then opened the door of the Waste Alchemy Room. The sun was shining brightly outside, and the birds were chirping, which made him feel very good.
At this moment, a fat little man with a tiger-like head and a thick head walked over and asked a little shyly: "Are you Senior Brother Chen Changsheng?"
Chen Changsheng took a look at the little fat man and found that he was fat and white, with a tiger-like head and a tiger-like head, and his eyes were very clear.
The young man rubbed the back of his head and felt a little embarrassed, "My name is Zhang Dahu, from the Spiritual Beast Park next door. I heard about your experience and felt so pitiful that I sent you some food."
After saying that, he took out a roast chicken wrapped in lotus leaves from his arms and handed it over, "Here."
"Ah! Thank you very much. Brother Zhang, why don't you come in and sit down?" Chen Changsheng couldn't help but feel warm in his heart when he looked at this little fat man. It seems that there are really many good people in the world!
Zhang Dahu waved his hand, "No, I have to clean up the feces of the spirit beast, so I'll leave first."
Zhang Dahu took two steps and then turned around and said, "Be careful about that Li Huaian, this guy doesn't have a good reputation."
"Well, you go ahead and eat. I'll give you something to eat when I have time." The little fat man said that and walked away.
Chen Changsheng did not eat the roasted chicken and gave it to Dan Lao who was sleeping deep in the abandoned alchemy room.
When Mr. Dan saw the roasted chicken, his eyes suddenly narrowed and he said, "Roasted chicken is great. Roast chicken and wine are one of the joys in life!"
At this moment, someone sent a cart of waste pills, and it turned out to be Chang Long.
Chang Long hesitated to speak, but in the end he turned around and left without saying anything.
Chen Changsheng didn't say hello to him either. He was the one who took the blame for this person. As a result, he didn't even say a word of pleading, which was a bit unjustifiable.
Underneath the Waste Pill were two hundred low-grade spiritual stones, as well as some Bigu Pills.
Chen Changsheng collected all these spirit stones and Bigu Pills. This was what he deserved. It seemed that Chang Long was still a human being and had not completely lost his humanity.
At this moment, a group of three people walked in swaggeringly, and it turned out to be Li Huaian and his two followers.
Chen Changsheng looked at this man with a cold look in his eyes, "Li Huaian, do you still dare to come?"
Li Huaian glanced around and saw the spirit stones and Bigu Pills that he had not yet put away. His eyes lit up, "Chen Changsheng, I originally came here today to give you a good beating, but if you give me these spirit stones and pills, I won't beat you up!"
"That's right, Chen Changsheng, you are a useless person who has been hiding in the useless alchemy room all your life. You can't practice even with so many spiritual stones. Why don't you respect us."
"Yes, these things of yours were given to you by Chang Long, so we will collect them for you."
Li Huaian is at the fifth level of Qi Refining, and the two people beside him are also at the third level of Qi Refining. In a one-on-one battle, Chen Changsheng is no match for either of them.
However, Chen Changsheng flicked his finger, and a poison pill suddenly exploded, and a black smoke suddenly filled the air.
Li Huaian and the other three were in a hurry and began to exorcise the poison. The spiritual energy in their bodies began to not function smoothly.
Chen Changsheng knocked Li Huaian to the ground with one punch, and then stepped on his chest, "Li Huaian, it's all because of you that I'm here, and you actually dare to cause trouble!"
